content.text: I want a small assistant for my household of four. Every morning it should read today's shared calendar events and chores, then send a short briefing with what needs attention. Once a week it should summarize overdue tasks, household budget status, maintenance items, and action points from our meeting notes. We should also be able to type “remind me to book the dentist next Thursday” and get a real task or calendar event. Some notes and calendar details are private, so the assistant must respect per-person visibility and ask before sending anything outside the household. Is this worth building on top of our existing calendar and task tools?

We use Google Calendar plus a shared task list and a private notes area. There is no reliable morning digest today; people check several places manually. What delivery timing and channel would be acceptable for the digests?
A digest at 7:30 on weekdays and a Sunday evening weekly report are enough. Email or a private Discord channel is acceptable, but a dashboard-only result is also fine for a first version.
The privacy boundary and model deployment could change the recommendation. What data may leave the home, and is self-hosting required?

Private notes must never be included in a household-wide report. We can use a hosted model only if each run shows what data leaves the home and everyone opts in; a self-hosted model is preferred if quality is usable.
Natural-language input can create a draft task or event, but must show the parsed date, owner, and visibility before saving. Should any action ever be sent or changed automatically?
Natural-language input may create a draft task or event, but it must show the parsed date, owner, and visibility before saving. Never silently change or send calendar data.

Pre-research understanding: a four-person household manually checks Google Calendar, shared tasks, and private notes; it wants weekday 7:30 and Sunday evening digests covering shared events, chores, overdue tasks, budget, maintenance, and meeting-note actions, delivered by email, private Discord, or a first-version dashboard. The core capability is a privacy-aware digest plus natural-language reminders that produce reviewable task/event drafts. Private notes stay out of household reports; hosted AI requires visible egress and unanimous opt-in, while self-hosting is preferred. Parsed date, owner, and visibility must be shown before any save, and calendar data must never be silently changed or sent. The proposed form is a small assistant layered on existing calendar and task tools. Please confirm.

Necessity check: concrete manual coordination pain is a fact; that a scheduled digest would reduce missed actions is an inference; exact willingness to maintain another system is unknown. The core function and proposed lightweight delivery fit the need, but no existing tool was yet verified against the full privacy, weekly-summary, and review-first contract.
